title: Ultem film sample

card.title: Ultem 1000 film
card.summary: Explore oxygen-limit tests on this specific PEI film.

sections.heading: Read the result
sections.body: The selected test lists its oxygen endpoint, pressure and apparatus. The star in ULOI* or MOC* identifies the short-duration reduced-gravity method.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: A sample is a link to material evidence. Its result does not rate an entire stove, handle or spacecraft.

atmosphere.label: Illustrative Earth-like cabin
atmosphere.basis: Design preset for an enclosed air-filled habitat. Not a measured Moon or Mars habitat.

measurements.label: Survived the short drop
measurements.explanation: Lowest tested oxygen concentration where the flame survived the full drop.

measurements.label: Extinguished during the drop
measurements.explanation: Highest tested oxygen concentration where the flame extinguished within the drop.

conditions.pressure_conversion: psia * 6.894757293168; display precision does not imply measurement precision
conditions.oxygen_role: varied to determine the reported endpoint; see measurements

tony_context.limitation: 1g ULOI/MOC use statistical burn criteria; low-g starred limits use drop-time survival/extinction; not equivalent safety certifications. Other-gravity rows partly reproduce earlier work. Unknown replicate counts. No exact habitat prediction.
tony_context.locator: Table I; method definitions PDF pages 2-4

limitations: Earth MOC/ULOI use burn-length and repeat-test criteria. Reduced-gravity MOC*/ULOI* describe extinction or survival during the short drop. They are not equivalent certification thresholds.
Survival for 5.18 seconds does not establish indefinite burning or a habitat safety limit.
